verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins documents all three distribution channels the story names. Marketplaces: `codex plugin marketplace add`, a public curated marketplace.json catalog, and the submission portal. Repos: local and repo marketplaces are explicitly called team-distribution sources. Project files: teams can check skills into `.agents/skills`, which Codex scans from the working directory up to the repo root. A runtime probe confirmed a real install from the catalog into `./.agents/skills`. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a team-wide rollout (e.g., org-managed or admin-pushed marketplace), plus clarity on surface-specific availability of repo marketplaces.
